name: scheduling
description: Defer any operation to run later — at a time, or after a delay. Load for reminders, delayed follow-ups, or timed automation.

content.inline:
## Scheduling
- schedule `{operation, input, time? | after?}` — registers a deferred invocation of ANY catalog op. `time` is an absolute timestamp (ISO8601 or epoch ms); `after` is a delay in ms. Returns a schedule entry id.
- list shows your pending schedules; cancel `{id}` removes one; trigger `{id}` fires it immediately.

Semantics:
- The scheduled call runs under YOUR authority, with the capabilities captured when you scheduled it — grant what the op will need at schedule time, never assume ambient authority later.
- Schedules persist on the venue and survive restarts.
- To schedule agent work, schedule `v/ops/agent/request` (a tracked task lands in the agent's queue when it fires).
- Recurring behaviour: have the scheduled op (or agent) schedule the next occurrence — there is no cron syntax.
